newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD to invest 100 bln yen on optical fibre cable.
newsitem.headline: KDD to invest 100 bln yen on optical fibre cable.

text.p: Japan's biggest international telecommunications carrier, Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD), said on Thursday it would invest 100 billion yen to lay an undersea optical fibre cable by 1999.
KDD said in a statement that the company plans to lay the 8,500 km cable around Japan's main islands. It is expected to be in use by mid-1999.
The undersea cable will loop around the main islands of Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu and have a capacity of 100 gigabits, or 1.2 million phone lines, the company said.
It said it had started feasibility studies to connect the cable with local call networks provided by nine regional telecommunications operators, it said.
